message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This primary-product scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`, combined with obvious aliases normalized and duplicates removed. The scan window was **2026-10-01 05:10 IST through 2026-10-02 05:10 IST** (2026-09-30 23:40 through 2026-10-01 23:40 UTC).

New relevant issues were confirmed for Apache HTTP Server, Keycloak, OpenSSL/Ubuntu, and several Ubuntu packages. Two related components require inventory confirmation.

### Apache HTTP Server 2.4.69 security release

- **Affected product/component:** Apache HTTP Server
- **Issues:** CVE-2026-42356, CVE-2026-42528, CVE-2026-46729, CVE-2026-47360, CVE-2026-48005, CVE-2026-56153, CVE-2026-56154, CVE-2026-56449, CVE-2026-57941, CVE-2026-58415, CVE-2026-59685, CVE-2026-59797, CVE-2026-63045, CVE-2026-63292, CVE-2026-63686, CVE-2026-63718, CVE-2026-73636, CVE-2026-73637, CVE-2026-79768, and CVE-2026-93546
- **Severity:** Apache rates 5 Moderate and 15 Low
- **Description:** Apache 2.4.69 fixes 20 flaws involving memory safety, denial of service, information exposure, request smuggling, authentication replay, and configuration-specific code execution risks. Most affect releases through 2.4.68; CVE-2026-42356 affects 2.4.60 through 2.4.68.
- **Relevance:** Apache HTTP Server is explicitly listed, including an Apache 2.4.29 deployment. That version falls within the affected range for most of this release's fixes.
- **Source:** [Apache HTTP Server 2.4 vulnerability advisory](https://httpd.apache.org/security/vulnerabilities_24)

### Keycloak X.509 client-certificate path traversal

- **Affected product/component:** Keycloak
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-103884
- **Severity:** Moderate, CVSS 6.5
- **Description:** With CRL Distribution Point checking enabled, a crafted client certificate can make Keycloak read local files or consume excessive memory, potentially exposing information or crashing the service.
- **Relevance:** Keycloak is explicitly listed in the assigned inventory.
- **Source:** [GitHub Advisory Database / NVD record](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xfh5-8fx4-3crm)

### Ubuntu/OpenSSL QUIC denial-of-service fixes

- **Affected product/component:** OpenSSL on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS
- **Issues:** CVE-2026-42772 and CVE-2026-54873
- **Severity:** Not stated in the Ubuntu notice
- **Description:** Malicious QUIC traffic can trigger excessive CPU use or retain excessive packet-buffer memory, causing denial of service.
- **Relevance:** Both Ubuntu and OpenSSL are explicit inventory entries. Canonical's in-window update is specific to Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, so deployed Ubuntu release and OpenSSL package versions should be checked.
- **Source:** [Ubuntu USN-8861-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8861-1)

### Ubuntu libXpm denial of service

- **Affected product/component:** Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04, and 26.04 LTS `libxpm`
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-94287
- **Severity:** Not stated in the Ubuntu notice
- **Description:** A specially crafted zero-dimension XPM image can cause excessive resource use and crash an application.
- **Relevance:** Ubuntu 22.04 and generic Ubuntu are listed; exposure depends on whether the affected package is installed.
- **Source:** [Ubuntu USN-8862-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8862-1)

### Ubuntu GStreamer Good Plugins vulnerabilities

- **Affected product/component:** Ubuntu `gst-plugins-good1.0`
- **Issues:** CVE-2026-17072, CVE-2026-73433, CVE-2026-73434, and CVE-2026-88914
- **Severity:** Not stated in the Ubuntu notice
- **Description:** Crafted FLAC, AVI, or closed-caption data can cause denial of service or expose memory contents.
- **Relevance:** The notice covers Ubuntu 22.04 and other listed Ubuntu families; exposure depends on package installation.
- **Source:** [Ubuntu USN-8863-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8863-1)

### Other Ubuntu package advisories

- **OpenStack Designate, CVE-2026-71193:** Authenticated users may redirect or disrupt DNS through overlapping-zone validation weaknesses. Relevant only if Designate is installed. Severity was not stated. [Ubuntu USN-8860-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8860-1)
- **KCoreAddons, CVE-2026-41526:** Incorrect shell-argument quoting can allow command execution in applications that pass attacker-controlled input to the affected method. The notice applies to Ubuntu 26.04 LTS only. Severity was not stated. [Ubuntu USN-8857-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8857-1)

### Possible matches needing review

**pgvector IVFFlat index build**
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-103484
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 8.8
- **Description:** pgvector before 0.8.7 may permit a database user to trigger an out-of-bounds write during IVFFlat index construction, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution.
- **Why review is needed:** PostgreSQL and several PostgreSQL extensions are listed, but pgvector itself is not. Confirm whether pgvector is deployed before treating this as applicable.
- **Source:** [GitHub Advisory Database / NVD record](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-pw7q-9788-x566)

**ansible-runner archive extraction**
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-103754
- **Severity:** Moderate, CVSS 5.9
- **Description:** Crafted streamed archives can exploit path traversal and unsafe symbolic links in `unstream_dir()` to write or alter files outside the target directory, potentially enabling code execution.
- **Why review is needed:** Ansible is listed, but `ansible-runner` and Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform are separate components. Confirm whether either is installed.
- **Source:** [Red Hat-linked CVE record](https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2026-103754)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes operators, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector/SQL Interface, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned alerts, GitHub advisories, CVE/NVD-oriented results, and CISA-oriented sources.

No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated within the exact 24-hour window. The newest MongoDB vendor security alert entries found were dated September 2026 and were outside scope.

### Review priority

Review Apache HTTP Server first because the inventory includes a substantially older affected version. Then validate Keycloak CRL checking and Ubuntu package exposure. Treat pgvector and ansible-runner as actionable only after confirming those components are installed.
